title: Spark Networking Night 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
resources: Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 44 attendees for this Networking Night, in line with turnout at our previous Networking Night events.
We can deliver this Networking Night efficiently within INR 8,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will improve campus community spirit and student wellbeing.
